title: Joe Flacco: What happens when we go to 18 games? Are they going to want 20, then 22?

sources.title: Joe Flacco: What happens when we go to 18 games? Are they going to want 20, then 22?
sources.description: Flacco recognizes that more games will mean more money, but he thinks there are drawbacks to a longer season.
